items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: Charlie Parker and Gillette's Bune, Stan Kenton, have brought up and many others before them.

ctx.x: So it's a direct pipeline from your heart and your mind into the next guy.

People. Even my musician. I think. I will tell you what I believe. That the musician that came up after this invasion of jazz, jazz did call for self-creation. Yeah. Take a melody and build it up and make something beautiful, more beautiful than what it is, but with your own imagination. And I think the new generation that came out after that invasion, they couldn't digest it. That might be wrong what I'm saying. They went on looking for something new because that, I suppose, they couldn't do it. Yeah. You see?…
